title: Tronsmart TWS Earbuds & Headphones Review: The Full Lineup Compared
metaDescription: Tronsmart wireless audio lineup reviewed: the Sounfii R4 TWS earbuds with ENC call noise reduction and the SOUNFII Q20S hybrid ANC headphones — which one actually fits your use case.
author: ByteBuy Team

sections.content: Tronsmart isn't trying to compete with Sony or Bose on headline features — it competes on price-to-feature ratio, and its audio lineup is small and deliberately focused rather than sprawling. Right now that lineup covers two very different use cases: the Sounfii R4, a true-wireless in-ear model built around call clarity, and the SOUNFII Q20S, an over-ear hybrid ANC headphone built for long listening sessions. Here's how they actually differ and which one fits what you're trying to do.

sections.title: Sounfii R4 vs. SOUNFII Q20S at a Glance

items.label: Form Factor
items.value: R4: true-wireless in-ear / Q20S: over-ear, foldable

items.label: Noise Handling
items.value: R4: ENC (call noise reduction) / Q20S: Hybrid ANC (ambient noise cancellation while listening)

items.label: Battery Life
items.value: Q20S: up to 60 hours total / R4: standard TWS case-extended runtime

items.label: Control
items.value: Both support the Tronsmart companion app

items.label: Best For
items.value: R4: calls, gym, commute / Q20S: flights, office, long focus sessions

pros: Sounfii R4's ENC noticeably cleans up your voice on calls in windy or noisy environments — that's a call-quality feature, not a listening one, and it does that job well
Q20S's hybrid ANC actually cancels ambient noise while you listen, not just on calls, which makes it the pick for flights or open offices
60-hour battery life on the Q20S means you're not thinking about charging it mid-week
Both are priced well under the equivalent Sony/Bose tier while covering the two most common real-world use cases
90° swiveling earpads and a foldable design on the Q20S make it realistic to actually carry around, not just use at a desk
cons: The lineup is genuinely small — if you want a mid-range TWS with ANC built in (not just ENC), Tronsmart doesn't have that model yet
Q20S is an over-ear design, so it's not a swap-in replacement for people who specifically want in-ear TWS with ANC
R4's noise reduction is call-focused (ENC), not a listening-mode ANC — don't expect it to quiet a noisy flight cabin
Neither model currently offers wireless charging on the case/headphones

items.question: Which Tronsmart earbuds should I choose?
items.answer: It comes down to what you actually do with them. If most of your use is calls — commuting, gym, walking while on a call — the Sounfii R4's ENC is built exactly for that. If you want long, uninterrupted listening with the outside world dialed down (flights, open-plan offices, focus sessions), the SOUNFII Q20S with hybrid ANC and 60-hour battery is the better fit, even though it's an over-ear design rather than true-wireless earbuds.

items.question: Are there affordable wireless earbuds with real noise cancellation?
items.answer: Among Tronsmart's current lineup, the SOUNFII Q20S is the one with genuine ANC (it cancels ambient noise while you're listening), and it's priced well below premium ANC headphones from bigger brands. The Sounfii R4 has ENC instead, which is a different feature — it cleans up your voice for the person on the other end of a call, not the sound you hear.

items.question: What's the difference between ENC and ANC?
items.answer: ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation) works on the microphone side — it strips background noise out of your voice so calls sound clearer to the other person. ANC (Active Noise Cancellation) works on the speaker side — it cancels ambient sound so you hear less of the outside world while listening. The Sounfii R4 has ENC; the SOUNFII Q20S has hybrid ANC. They solve different problems, and it's worth checking which one your use case actually needs before buying.

items.question: Is the Q20S worth it over cheaper generic ANC headphones?
items.answer: The two things that stand out for the price point are Hi-Res Audio certification and genuinely long battery life (up to 60 hours), plus multipoint pairing with two devices at once. If those three matter to you, it's a reasonable step up from unbranded ANC headphones in the same price bracket.

sections.content: Tronsmart's audio lineup is small on purpose — two models, two clearly different jobs. The Sounfii R4 is the pick if calls are the priority and you want true-wireless convenience. The SOUNFII Q20S is the pick if long listening sessions with real ambient noise cancellation matter more than in-ear form factor. Match the model to what you actually use headphones for, rather than defaulting to whichever one shows up first in search.
